body:
selfhost/emit.prn now supports or/and/not as a call argument, closing the last exclusion from the prior round. While building it, found and fixed 3 more real, live, silently-wrong-C bugs of the exact same class the prior round's bool-op-symbol? fix caught one instance of: (f (Some s)) called an undefined 'Some' function (fixed with real Ok/Err/Some construction support), a bare (f None) referenced an undeclared identifier (fixed with real option_none() support), and (f (cond ...)) emitted THREE bogus calls at once via a clause-shape collision (fixed with a broader other-special-form-symbol? exclusion covering cond/match/with-arena/let). 10 new tests including 2 real compile+run+assert checks. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean. PARENA commit 8b6b776.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: or/and/not-as-a-call-argument support + fixed 3 more real silently-wrong-C bugs
